name: FFS_ACTIVITY_REQ_INVENTORY
description: Contains inventory items required to perform particular activities.

columns.name: ARCH_DATE
columns.description: DB record partitioning date. Set automatically by DB Optimization job.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of Required Inventory, automatically populated by the system.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_ACTIVITY.ACTIVITY_ID value. ID of the Activity the Inventory is required for.

columns.name: TYPE_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_INVENTORY_TYPE.TYPE_ID value. ID of the Required Inventory type.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of Inventory which is required.

columns.name: MODEL
columns.description: Model of Inventory type which is required.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
